test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: There are 45 persons (only male and female) in a group. The ratio of the number of males and females is 5 : 4. If the average weight of males is 79.4 kg and that of females is 64.5 kg, then what will be the average weight (in kg) of all the individuals in the group (corrected to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Formula:**

Average weight = Total weight of all persons ÷ Total persons in the group

**Calculation:**

Total males in the group = 5over 9 × 45 = 25

Total females in the group = 4over 9 × 45 = 20

Total weight of all the males = 79.4 kg × 25 = 1,985 kg

Total weight of all the females = 64.5 kg × 20 = 1,290 kg

Total weight of all the persons = 1,985 + 1,290 = 3,275 kg

Average weight = 3,275 ÷ 45 = 72.8 kg (corrected to one decimal place)

∴ **The average weight of all individuals in the group is 72.8 kg.**
